content: Implement the first M0130 W0135 cache slice: define deterministic portable/device cache identities and a bounded in-memory catalog with corruption removal, live-reference pinning, quota eviction, and key-mutation misses; do not claim Vulkan pipeline creation or warm-launch qualification.

Content revision 073376d adds CacheIdentity portable/device canonical keys and CacheCatalog. The catalog models bounded publication, hit/miss behavior, corrupt unpinned removal, live-reference pinning, and LRU quota eviction; key fields include Kernel IR, target, compiler/lowering/tool epochs, FP, argument/backend ABI, specialization, and device/driver UUIDs.

Vulkan configure/build and full CTest passed 87/87, including cache key, corruption, pinning, and quota fixtures; Agent records and git diff checks passed. Filesystem publication, opaque VkPipelineCache data, and warm-launch tracing remain open.
